title: Break Process Cooldown Bar
description:
Displays the block breaking process using the cooldown bar.
It uses the Games Cooldown bar / sword icon to display the current block breaking progress. It slowly fills up the bar or the sword based on the progress.
body:
Simple Mod that displays the current block breaking progress in the Cooldown Bar.
It uses the Games Cooldown bar / sword icon to display the current block breaking progress. It slowly fills up the bar or the sword based on the progress.
